g.text: Research prioritization · values are policy choices, not validated toxicity thresholds
Same tier and IHC grade use linked native TPM/nTPM numbers; CP10K is nominal /100.
Only named adult HPA cell compartments change tiers. Bulk keeps its organ tier.
Undifferentiated bowel cells retain a stem/progenitor caution; Medium/High HPA protein and clinical exclusions remain active.
